what: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
title: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
text: servcat provides R interface ServCat, authoritative repository U.S. Fish Wildlife Service (FWS) data reference information. Use package search ServCat, retrieve reference metadata, inspect related units subject categories, access saved collections, download files associated ServCat references.

title: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
text: can install development version servcat GitHub : load package:

what: Search for references by their ID
title: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
text: ServCat references unique reference IDs. already know reference ID, can retrieve reference record directly. useful want inspect metadata known ServCat item, title, abstract, publication date, authors, associated files, related organizational information.

title: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
text: Use advanced_search() search ServCat one search criteria. Search criteria sent body POST request, paging options control many records returned. can combine multiple criteria request body: exact fields available advanced search depend ServCat API. Common criteria may include text search terms, title keywords, author names, subject categories, reference types, organizations, dates, geographic filters.
code: results <- advanced_search(   criteria = list(     quickSearch = "Kodiak goats"   ),   page = 1,   page_size = 25 )  results results <- advanced_search(   criteria = list(     quickSearch = "wetlands",     title = "inventory",     subjectCategories = c("Habitat", "Wetlands")   ),   page = 1,   page_size = 50 )

title: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
text: ServCat endpoints return additional composite detail reference. Use composite search need richer results standard advanced search response. Composite results may include additional nested information reference, related files, organizations, people, subjects, associated metadata.
code: composite_results <- advanced_search(   criteria = list(     quickSearch = "Kodiak, goats"   ),   page = 1,   page_size = 25,   composite = TRUE )  composite_results

what: Retrieve references from a saved collection
title: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
text: ServCat saved collections group related references. Use get_collection_references() saved collection ID retrieve references collection. useful working curated groups references, project collections, regional datasets, topic-based ServCat collections.

title: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
text: Many ServCat references include one associated files. Use download_reference_files() download files attached reference. can also use function loop lapply()/purrr::map() download files multiple references.
code: download_reference_files(   reference_id = 140411,   path = "data-raw/servcat-files" ) reference_ids <- c(140411, 140412, 140413)  lapply(   reference_ids,   download_reference_files,   path = "data-raw/servcat-files" )

what: Get units associated with a reference
title: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
text: ServCat references can associated one FWS units. Use get_reference_units() retrieve units.

title: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
text: Use get_reference_bounding_boxes() retrieve geographic bounding box coordinates associated reference. Bounding boxes can help identify geographic extent reference may useful mapping spatial filtering workflows.

title: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
text: Use get_reference_subjects() retrieve subject categories associated ServCat reference. Subject categories can help classify references topic support targeted searches.

title: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
text: Use get_reference_types() retrieve list ServCat reference types. Reference types can useful building advanced searches filtering results particular kinds records.

title: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
text: typical workflow might look like :
code: library(servcat)  # Search ServCat results <- advanced_search(   criteria = list(     quickSearch = "Kodiak goats"   ),   page = 1,   page_size = 10,   composite = TRUE )  # Inspect one reference ID from the results ref <- get_reference(140411)  # Retrieve related metadata units <- get_reference_units(140411) subjects <- get_reference_subjects(140411) bbox <- get_reference_bounding_boxes(140411)  # Download associated files download_reference_files(   reference_id = 140411,   path = "data-raw/servcat-files" )

title: R Interface for the FWS ServCat API
text: servcat wraps ServCat REST API returns R objects suitable downstream analysis, reporting, data management workflows. ServCat records can vary structure, returned fields may missing, empty, nested depending reference, endpoint, search type used.

title: Execute an Advanced Search — search_references_advanced
code: search_references_advanced(   criteria,   top = 25,   page = 1,   orderby = NULL,   sort = NULL,   composite = FALSE,   secure = FALSE,   api_key = NULL )

title: Execute an Advanced Search — search_references_advanced
text: criteria named list Advanced Search criteria. Supported top-level fields include: quickSearch character string search using ServCat Quick Search. supplied, Quick Search primary source results, filters applied results. visibility Optional visibility filter. Use "public" return public records, "internal" return internal records, NULL return available. Non-secure services can return public records. legacy Optional legacy-status filter. Use "excludelegacy" return non-legacy records, "onlylegacy" return legacy records, NULL ignore legacy status. version Optional version filter. Use "" include versions versioned records, NULL return recent version. regions list Region filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, unitCode. units list Unit filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, unitCode, linked, approved. textFields list text-field filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, fieldName, searchText. Valid fieldName values include "Abstract", "Notes", "TableOfContent", "ContactName", "Publisher", "Keyword", "MiscellaneousCode", "Title", "DisplayCitation". dates list date filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, fieldName, filter, startDate, endDate. Valid fieldName values include "DateOfIssue", "ContentBeginDate", "ContentEndDate", "LastEdited", "DateCreated". Valid filter values include "BeforeDate", "AfterDate", "BetweenDates", "Exactly", "NotEquals", "NotBetween". referenceTypes list Reference Type filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, referenceType. referenceGroups list Reference Type Group filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, group. rectangles One bounding boxes represented OGC Well-Known Text polygon strings, example "POLYGON((-121.8 45.7,-116.4 45.7,-116.4 42.0,-121.86 42.0,-121.8 45.7))". subjectCategories list Subject Category filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, subjectCategory, subjectCategory numeric Subject Category identifier. digitalResources list Files Links filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, type, fieldName, searchText. Valid type values include "DigitalFile", "ExternalLink", "WebService". physicalCopies list Physical Copy filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, unitCode, searchText. collections list Saved Collection filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, collection, collection numeric Saved Collection identifier. people list Owner Creator filters. entry may include order, logicOperator, fieldName, searchText. Valid fieldName values include "Creator" "Owner". searchText value staff UPN partner user code. criteria sections accept multiple entries, logicOperator can used combine exclude criteria. Common values include "", "", "". Group operators "ANDGROUP", "ORGROUP", "NOTGROUP" may used supported ServCat API. top Number entries per page. Defaults 25. Use larger integer, 1000, reduce paging, avoid values large request may time . page One-based page index return. Defaults 1. orderby Optional name single field sort results. sort Optional sort direction. Must "ASC" "DESC" supplied. composite Logical. TRUE, use composite Advanced Search endpoint, returns additional nested detail linked resources associated units. Defaults FALSE. secure Logical. Use secure API? api_key Optional secure API key.

title: Execute an Advanced Search — search_references_advanced
text: tibble Advanced Search result items. Page metadata response stored "page_detail" attribute. composite = TRUE, returned tibble may include list-columns linkedResources units.

title: Execute an Advanced Search — search_references_advanced
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Quick Search using the Advanced Search endpoint results <- search_references_advanced(   criteria = list(     quickSearch = "Kodiak, goats"   ) )  results  # View paging metadata attr(results, "page_detail")  # Request more results per page results <- search_references_advanced(   criteria = list(     quickSearch = "Kodiak, goats"   ),   top = 100 )  # Return composite results with linked resources and units composite_results <- search_references_advanced(   criteria = list(     quickSearch = "Kodiak, goats"   ),   composite = TRUE )  # Search public records and sort by issue date results <- search_references_advanced(   criteria = list(     quickSearch = "Kodiak, goats",     visibility = "public"   ),   top = 100,   page = 1,   orderby = "dateOfIssue",   sort = "DESC" )  # Search by reference type reports <- search_references_advanced(   criteria = list(     referenceTypes = list(       list(         order = 1,         logicOperator = NULL,         referenceType = "Unpublished Report"       )     )   ) )  # Search within title text title_results <- search_references_advanced(   criteria = list(     textFields = list(       list(         order = 1,         logicOperator = NULL,         fieldName = "Title",         searchText = "mountain goat"       )     )   ) )  # Search by date range date_results <- search_references_advanced(   criteria = list(     dates = list(       list(         order = 1,         logicOperator = NULL,         fieldName = "DateOfIssue",         filter = "BetweenDates",         startDate = "2010-01-01",         endDate = "2020-12-31"       )     )   ) )  # Search for records with public digital files file_results <- search_references_advanced(   criteria = list(     digitalResources = list(       list(         order = 1,         logicOperator = NULL,         type = "DigitalFile",         fieldName = NULL,         searchText = NULL       )     )   ) ) } # }

title: servcat: Access the ServCat REST API — servcat-package
text: Provides R functions querying U.S. Fish Wildlife Service ServCat REST API. package includes helpers retrieving reference records, reference-associated metadata, fixed-list lookup values, digital resources, saved collections, Advanced Search results.
